c74object.name: bbb.opendmxusb
c74object.digest: Send DMX through an ENTTEC OPEN DMX USB serial port
c74object.description: macOS FTDI virtual serial port output. One 512-channel buffer, no universe or IP settings. Choose a port using attrui; ports or refresh updates the choices.

outlet.digest: Serial-frame completion bang or dump list
ports, opened, closed, error, status, coalesced

method.name: list
method.digest: Update levels from the first channel; request output according to mode

method.name: channel
method.digest: Set channel and value; request output according to mode

method.name: set
method.digest: Store levels without a send request

method.name: setchannel
method.digest: Store one channel and value without a send request

method.name: set_offset
method.digest: Store values beginning at a channel without a send request

method.name: bang
method.digest: Request the current frame in any mode

method.name: dump
method.digest: Output stored levels before blackout masking

method.name: ports
method.digest: List serial ports and refresh the port attribute choices

method.name: open
method.digest: Reconnect selected port, or select and connect the supplied path

method.name: close
method.digest: Disconnect while retaining the port selection and levels

method.name: status
method.digest: Output connection flag and selected port

attribute.name: port
attribute.digest: Callout serial device path; none disconnects

attribute.name: blackout
attribute.digest: Mask outgoing levels with zero without erasing stored values

attribute.name: verbose
attribute.digest: Print connection events in Max Console
